en.commentary:
I judge a protein powder on three things that actually matter: how much real protein lands in each scoop, what else is hiding in the tub, and whether you will keep buying it once the novelty wears off. By that standard the Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Isolate is the best protein powder you can buy in 2026. At 28g of protein for a 32g scoop, it is 88% protein by weight, which is about as efficient as whey isolate gets, and the label is spotless: no artificial sweeteners, no fillers, no dyes, with Informed Choice testing on every batch. At roughly $2 a serving it costs more than a budget tub, but you are paying for grams of protein per dollar that hold up under scrutiny.

The Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard at number two is the one I recommend to most people, and it has earned that the hard way by staying the best-selling whey in America for over twenty years. It mixes instantly with nothing but a spoon, tastes genuinely good in plain water, and its Vanilla Ice Cream flavor landed in the top 10% of all proteins tested for heavy metals and contaminants. For the price, nothing touches its combination of convenience and quality. Momentous takes third on the strength of its NSF Certified for Sport status, which is the certification that matters if you get drug tested, and Nutricost claims fourth as the budget king at about a dollar a scoop for a 5-pound tub.

The back half of this list is about matching a powder to a need. Klean Athlete is the minimalist NSF isolate for athletes who want nothing extra. Garden of Life Sport is the best plant-based protein for anyone avoiding dairy, with a full 30g and dual sport certification. Raw Nutrition's CBUM line wins purely on taste, with dessert flavors that make a daily shake something to look forward to. Naked Whey is the single-ingredient purist's choice, Ritual is the pick for label obsessives, and Orgain is the organic plant protein you can grab at any grocery store for under thirty bucks. There is a right answer here for every goal and every budget.

highlights.title: Transparent Labs wins because it gives you the most protein with the least junk
highlights.body: Most whey tubs pad their scoop weight with cheap fillers, gums, and artificial sweeteners that inflate the serving size without adding protein. Transparent Labs goes the other way: 28g of protein in a 32g scoop puts it at 88% protein by weight, near the ceiling for whey isolate, and the rest of the label is just stevia and natural flavor. Informed Choice certification on every batch means an independent lab has verified it is free of banned substances and matches its label. When I rank on protein quality and ingredient purity together, nothing else comes close to this efficiency.

highlights.title: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard is the protein I hand to beginners and never apologize for
highlights.body: Twenty years as America's best-selling whey is not an accident. Gold Standard nails the two things that make people actually stick with a protein: it dissolves instantly with a spoon and no shaker drama, and it tastes good enough to drink in plain water. Beyond convenience, its Vanilla Ice Cream flavor finished in the top 10% of all proteins independently tested for heavy metals, pesticides, and plasticizers, earning an overall A grade. You get 24g of protein and 5.5g of naturally occurring BCAAs per scoop at a price that undercuts almost every premium tub. For most people, this is the smart default.

highlights.title: Momentous is the only pick that matters if you get drug tested
highlights.body: NSF Certified for Sport is the highest bar in the supplement industry. It screens every batch for over 270 banned substances, verifies the label is accurate, and audits the manufacturing facility itself. For a college athlete, a military member, or anyone competing under anti-doping rules, that certification is the difference between a safe purchase and a failed test. Momentous backs it with cold-processed European grass-fed whey isolate and a clean formula. It delivers 20g per serving rather than the 24-28g of the leaders, so it is not the most protein per scoop, and it costs more, but for tested athletes the peace of mind is the entire point.

highlights.title: Nutricost proves you do not need to overpay to hit your protein target
highlights.body: Hitting a gram of protein per pound of bodyweight gets expensive fast when you are paying $2 a scoop. Nutricost solves that with a 5-pound tub delivering 25g of protein per serving at roughly a dollar a scoop, third-party tested and made in the USA. The flavoring is simpler and it mixes a touch thicker than premium isolates, but the protein is real and the price per gram is the best on this list. For anyone eating big to build muscle, this is the tub that keeps a high-protein diet affordable month after month.

highlights.title: Garden of Life Sport is the plant protein that actually competes with whey
highlights.body: Plant proteins usually force a compromise on amino acid completeness or protein quantity. Garden of Life Sport refuses both. It packs 30g of organic plant protein with 5.5g of BCAAs and 5g of glutamine, and it carries both NSF Certified for Sport and Informed Choice certification, which almost no vegan protein can claim. For athletes who avoid dairy, whether for lactose intolerance, ethics, or digestion, this is the one that delivers a complete amino profile and competition-grade testing in the same scoop. It is the plant-based protein I recommend without hesitation.

en.commentary:
This is the week the heavy metals story stopped being a background hum and became the single most useful filter for choosing a protein powder. On July 7 seven consumers filed a proposed class action over Orgain Organic Protein sold at Costco, citing independent lab work that reported lead as high as 67 ppb. Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has opened an industry wide investigation into protein powder manufacturers over lead and cadmium. Neither is an FDA recall, and I want to be precise about that, but both point at the same structural fact: plant protein draws its amino acids from crops that pull trace metals out of soil, and rice and cocoa are the two worst offenders in that regard.

I trimmed Orgain's purity mark to 8.3 and its overall to 7.8 this week. That is a deliberate, small move. The product still delivers a genuinely good value per gram and mixes cleanly into oat milk, and the allegations are allegations. What changed is my confidence in the lot to lot ceiling, and purity is a factor I score on evidence rather than intent.

Everything above rank 10 stays where it was, because the leaders already solved this problem years ago. Klean Athlete and Legion carry NSF Certified for Sport, meaning an outside lab pulls product off the shelf and tests it against a contaminant panel. Momentous does the same through Informed Sport.

My practical advice is simple. If you drink one to two scoops daily, whey isolate from a certified line carries the lowest metal exposure per gram of protein by a wide margin. If you want plant protein for digestive or ethical reasons, Garden of Life Sport is the one I trust here, and its 9.3 purity reflects NSF certification rather than a marketing claim on the tub.

What matters is whether a result exceeds an established safety threshold. Reading results with that framing gives you a much more accurate picture of risk.

highlights.body: At 9.3 Optimum Nutrition has kept this formula stable for decades and prices it well below the premium tier. For someone taking a scoop daily as general protein support, the formula differences further up this list are modest and the cost difference across a year is not.

zh-tw.commentary:
這個類別整個夏天都在一場關於乳清蛋白重金屬的公開爭論中間，而能從裡面拿走的有用東西，是一條更清楚的購買原則。

業界的回應點出了一件值得理解的事：偵測到微量元素，跟超過安全閾值，是兩種不同的結果，而現代儀器能偵測的濃度，遠低於任何有意義的水準。話說回來，底下那個重點本身還是成立的。補充品上市前不經審查，所以第三方認證是買家唯一能拿到的獨立驗證。挑一罐掛著 NSF Certified for Sport、Informed Sport 或 USP Verified 的粉，這個問題就自己解決了。

Transparent Labs 100% 草飼乳清分離蛋白以 9.5 守住第一，就是建立在這個基礎上，再加上真正乾淨的配方：沒有人工甜味劑、成分標示完整揭露，而且分離乳清沖泡不結塊。

9.3 分的 Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 是性價比答案，配方幾十年維持一致，這件事有它的份量。8.9 分的 Momentous 具備 NSF Certified for Sport，適合需要受檢的運動員。

highlights.title: 第三方認證是買家唯一的獨立查核
highlights.body: 補充品上市前不經審查，所以 NSF Certified for Sport、Informed Sport 跟 USP Verified 就是驗證內容物並篩檢汙染的機制。合格實驗室依 ISO 17025 執行 ICP-MS 檢測。選一罐有認證的粉，汙染這個問題就不必靠解讀新聞標題來回答。

highlights.title: Transparent Labs 贏在配方誠實，跟純度一樣重要
highlights.body: 沒有人工甜味劑，每一項成分跟劑量都完整標示，分離乳清也溶得乾淨。9.5 分，它真的做到大多數罐子上行銷文案在暗示的那件事，而完整揭露讓你可以自己驗證。這個組合就是它拿第一的原因。

highlights.title: 「偵測到」跟「超標」是兩種不同的結果
highlights.body: 儀器現在能在遠低於警戒水準的濃度下量到微量元素，所以一次偵測本身就只是一個量測值。真正重要的是結果有沒有超過已建立的安全閾值。用這個框架去讀報告，你對風險的圖像會準確得多。

highlights.title: Gold Standard 的位置，靠的是穩定跟價格
highlights.body: 9.3 分，Optimum Nutrition 把這個配方維持了幾十年，定價也遠低於高階層級。對於每天一匙、拿來當一般蛋白質補充的人來說，榜單再往上那些配方差異很有限，而一整年下來的價差可不小。

en.commentary: Transparent Labs 100% Grass-Fed Whey Isolate holds first at 9.5 and third-party testing has become the deciding factor in this category. The Texas Attorney General opened an industry-wide investigation into heavy metal contamination in plant-based protein powders, and while whey is a different production chain, the sensible response for every protein buyer is to demand published batch testing. Transparent Labs provides it, discloses every ingredient with no proprietary blends, and delivers 28 grams of protein per scoop with minimal additives. That combination is what a protein powder should be. Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard at 9.3 has the longest track record in the industry, the widest flavour range and the best availability, and it remains the powder I recommend most often on pure practicality. Momentous Essential Whey at 8.9 is NSF Certified for Sport, which matters for tested athletes. NoBull Whey Isolate at 8.9 is a clean formulation. Nutricost Whey Concentrate at 8.9 is the value leader by a significant margin, and concentrate is perfectly adequate for anyone without lactose sensitivity. Guidance worth repeating: isolate costs more and matters only if concentrate upsets your digestion. Most people can take concentrate and put the savings toward eating more actual food, which will do more for their training than any powder.

highlights.title: Demand published batch testing this year
highlights.body: The Texas Attorney General’s contamination investigation has made third-party heavy metal testing a purchasing requirement. Brands publishing batch certificates earn the sale, and those declining to answer have answered.

highlights.title: Concentrate is fine unless lactose upsets you
highlights.body: Isolate costs meaningfully more and the only real advantage is lower lactose content. If concentrate sits well with your digestion, the savings are better spent on food, which does more for training than any powder.

highlights.title: NSF Certified for Sport matters if you are tested
highlights.body: Momentous carries certification that verifies the absence of banned substances. For a competitive athlete subject to testing, that verification is a requirement, and for everyone else it is a reasonable quality signal.

highlights.title: Optimum Nutrition wins on practicality
highlights.body: The longest track record, the widest flavour range and reliable availability everywhere make it the powder I recommend most often. A protein you can actually buy consistently beats a marginally better one you cannot.

zh-tw.commentary:
Transparent Labs 100% 草飼乳清分離蛋白守第一，9.5 分，而第三方檢測在這個類別已經從加分項變成決定性因素。

美國德州檢察總長對植物性蛋白粉的重金屬污染展開全業界調查，雖然乳清是不同的生產鏈，但每一個買蛋白粉的人合理的反應都一樣，要求公開的批次檢測。

Transparent Labs 提供了，成分全部揭露、沒有專有配方，每匙 28 公克蛋白質、添加物極少。這個組合就是蛋白粉該有的樣子。

Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 的 9.3 業界資歷最長、口味最多、通路最好，純以實用性來說，這還是我最常推薦的一罐。

Momentous Essential Whey 的 8.9 有 NSF Certified for Sport，受藥檢的運動員需要這個。NoBull Whey Isolate 的 8.9 配方乾淨。Nutricost Whey Concentrate 的 8.9 是性價比領先幅度最大的，而濃縮乳清對沒有乳糖不耐的人完全夠用。

值得再講一次的建議，分離乳清比較貴，只有在濃縮會讓你腸胃不適時才有意義。多數人吃濃縮就好，省下來的錢拿去多買真正的食物，對訓練的幫助大過任何一罐粉。

highlights.title: 今年一定要求公開批次檢測
highlights.body: 德州檢察總長的污染調查，已經讓第三方重金屬檢測變成採購的必要條件。公開批次證明的品牌值得成交，拒絕回答的品牌其實已經回答了。

highlights.title: 沒有乳糖不耐就吃濃縮
highlights.body: 分離乳清貴不少，唯一的實質優勢是乳糖含量較低。濃縮吃了腸胃沒問題的話，省下來的錢拿去買食物，對訓練的幫助大過任何一罐粉。

highlights.title: 受藥檢的人要看 NSF Certified for Sport
highlights.body: Momentous 有驗證不含禁藥成分的認證。受藥檢規範的競技運動員，這是必要條件，其他人則可以把它當成一個合理的品質訊號。

highlights.title: Optimum Nutrition 贏在實用
highlights.body: 業界資歷最長、口味最多、到處都買得到，讓它成為我最常推薦的一罐。一罐你能穩定買到的蛋白粉，勝過一罐好那麼一點但缺貨的。
